goal: Make one small, low-risk code-quality or UI robustness improvement in Esbiko's existing Solar System simulation only, then verify it. Do not inspect unrelated simulations.
rules: Work only inside src/simulations/subjects/astronomy/space/solar-system, except repository-owned verification commands.
Inspect only the Solar System simulation files needed for one small improvement; do not explore the wider Esbiko repository.
Choose one obvious low-risk implementation, UI, accessibility, or robustness issue. Do not change orbital equations, scientific constants, planet/moon facts, or scientifically correct behaviour.
Make at most one tightly scoped source-code fix using guarded project.write SHA.
Do not modify generated files, credentials, deployment configuration, package-lock.json, or production data.
Do not deploy, publish, push, merge, or contact external services.
Stop exploring once enough evidence exists for one safe fix. Prefer completion over finding the best possible improvement.
Do not claim completion until deterministic verification and independent review pass.

steps.goal: Inspect a few files in the Solar System simulation, identify one simple low-risk non-scientific issue, make one small fix, then finish so verification can run.
